source_title: When you write a story, you begin to see cinema differently: Nirup Bhandari - The Times of India
source_excerpt: After making a mark with Rangi Taranga (2015), actor Nirup Bhandari has consciously sought out characters that take him beyond the serious and intense image audiences associate with him. In his upcoming film Sathya: Son of Harishchandra, he has once again taken up screenplay and dialogue writing as he collaborates with debutant director Sachin Vaali to shape the story.In an interview with Bangalore Times, Nirup talks about how he chooses his projects, what the past ten years have taught him, and the kinds of roles he wants to take on in the future.
